$comment: Every exception to 'a green npm test means everything ran'. Entries need a reason and must still match something, or check:tests fails. See tools/scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs.

entries.reason: Five tests start the real Quality service, whose executable lives in praxis-runtime since the repository split. They skip when apps/quality-service is absent from this checkout and are covered end to end by praxis-runtime accept:quality-startup. The other seven tests in the file run.
The test needs a permission failure that root bypasses; it is skipped only when the suite runs as uid 0.
Excludes dependency and fixture directories from collection, not tests.
